_about: Hand-authored crosswalk from CIP 2020 four-digit families (NCES Classification of Instructional Programs) to Inkling's 163 HESA CAH3 subject codes. One CIP maps to one or two subjects. 'confidence': 'low' marks a best-effort placement where the US family has no clean UK equivalent (or the CIP title/number is recalled from memory and should be checked against the NCES CIP 2020 list). Validate with: python3 -I scripts/us/build_crosswalk.py
